examples.zh: 我买了一张彩票，没中奖。
examples.en: I bought a lottery ticket but didn't win.

examples.zh: 他每周都买彩票。
examples.en: He buys lottery tickets every week.

examples.zh: 别想靠彩票挣钱。
examples.en: Don't count on the lottery to make money.

meaning: to recycle; to collect for reuse; to take back

senses.en: to recycle; to collect for reuse; to take back

note: 回收垃圾, 回收旧手机; also to recover money or goods.

examples.zh: 这些旧衣服可以回收。
examples.en: These old clothes can be recycled.

examples.zh: 我们家门口有回收旧手机的地方。
examples.en: Near our front door there's a place that collects old phones.

examples.zh: 瓶子用完要回收，别乱扔。
examples.en: Recycle bottles after use; don't throw them around.

note: Takes water or liquid: 泼水, 泼了一身水.

examples.zh: 他不小心把水泼到我身上了。
examples.en: He accidentally splashed water on me.

examples.zh: 别往地上泼水。
examples.en: Don't splash water on the floor.

examples.zh: 她生气地把茶泼在地上。
examples.en: She angrily threw the tea onto the ground.

note: More formal than 跟; 跟随 + person or trend.

examples.zh: 孩子跟随父母去了北京。
examples.en: The child went to Beijing with his parents.

examples.zh: 我们要跟随时代的变化。
examples.en: We must keep up with the changes of the times.

examples.zh: 游客们跟随导游参观了博物馆。
examples.en: The tourists followed the guide around the museum.

meaning: to stay for a while; to stop over; to remain (at a stage)

senses.en: to stay for a while; to stop over; to remain (at a stage)

note: 停留 + 时间 or place: 停留三天, 在北京停留.

examples.zh: 我在上海停留了三天。
examples.en: I stayed in Shanghai for three days.

examples.zh: 请不要在门口停留。
examples.en: Please don't linger at the doorway.

examples.zh: 你的签证能停留多久？
examples.en: How long can you stay on your visa?

meaning: awkward; hard to deal with; to make things hard for someone

senses.en: awkward; hard to deal with; to make things hard for someone

note: Two uses: 感到为难 (feel awkward), 为难 + person (give someone a hard time).

examples.zh: 你别为难他了，他也没办法。
examples.en: Don't make things hard for him; he has no choice either.

examples.zh: 借钱的事，让我很为难。
examples.en: Being asked to lend money puts me in an awkward position.

examples.zh: 如果你觉得为难，就直接告诉我。
examples.en: If you find it difficult, just tell me directly.

meaning: on the spot; right there and then

senses.en: on the spot; right there and then

note: Goes before the verb: 当场决定, 当场付钱.

examples.zh: 他当场就同意了。
examples.en: He agreed on the spot.

examples.zh: 这个人被警察当场抓住了。
examples.en: This man was caught on the spot by the police.

examples.zh: 你可以当场试一下，合适再买。
examples.en: You can try it on right here and buy it if it fits.

meaning: rare; hard to come by; seldom

senses.en: rare; hard to come by; seldom

note: Also praise: 难得你来 means "nice of you to come".

examples.zh: 今天难得有空，我们出去吃饭吧。
examples.en: It's rare to have free time today; let's go out to eat.

examples.zh: 这么好的机会很难得。
examples.en: A chance this good is hard to come by.

examples.zh: 难得你来，多坐一会儿吧。
examples.en: How nice of you to come; stay a while longer.

note: 早期 + 发现/治疗 (early detection, early treatment).

examples.zh: 这种病早期发现，治疗效果好。
examples.en: If this illness is found early, treatment works well.

examples.zh: 这是他早期的作品。
examples.en: This is his early work.

examples.zh: 早期的手机只能打电话。
examples.en: Early mobile phones could only make calls.

examples.zh: 这些葡萄又甜又大。
examples.en: These grapes are sweet and big.

examples.zh: 我想买一斤葡萄。
examples.en: I'd like to buy a jin of grapes.

examples.zh: 吃葡萄以前要洗干净。
examples.en: Wash grapes clean before eating them.

note: 共享单车 (shared bikes), 共享充电宝, 资源共享.

examples.zh: 我和朋友共享一个房间。
examples.en: My friend and I share a room.

examples.zh: 这份文件我共享给你了。
examples.en: I've shared this file with you.

examples.zh: 同事们共享一间办公室。
examples.en: The colleagues share one office.

note: 墙 is the everyday word; 墙壁 is slightly more formal.

examples.zh: 请不要在墙壁上乱画。
examples.en: Please don't scribble on the wall.

examples.zh: 这面墙壁该刷一刷了。
examples.en: This wall needs a new coat of paint.

examples.zh: 房间的墙壁是白色的。
examples.en: The walls of the room are white.

meaning: up and down; top to bottom; about (a number)

senses.en: up and down; top to bottom; about (a number)

note: Before a number it means "around": 三十岁上下.

examples.zh: 他三十岁上下，是一位医生。
examples.en: He is around thirty years old, and a doctor.

examples.zh: 电梯上下都很方便。
examples.en: The elevator makes going up and down convenient.

examples.zh: 全公司上下都在加班。
examples.en: The whole company, from top to bottom, is working overtime.

meaning: spoken words; speech; what one says

senses.en: spoken words; speech; what one says

note: Slightly formal or literary; 言语不通 means a language barrier.

examples.zh: 他言语不多，但很热心。
examples.en: He says little but is very warm-hearted.

examples.zh: 出国时，言语不通很麻烦。
examples.en: A language barrier is troublesome when you go abroad.

examples.zh: 请注意你的言语，别伤害别人。
examples.en: Watch your words and don't hurt others.

note: Always used with a negative: 再也不/没/没有.

examples.zh: 我再也不想吃这个了。
examples.en: I never want to eat this again.

examples.zh: 他走了以后，我再也没见过他。
examples.en: After he left, I never saw him again.

examples.zh: 我再也受不了了！
examples.en: I can't stand it any more!

note: Separable-ish and formal: 签约仪式, 正式签约; the person signs with a company.

examples.zh: 他昨天和公司签约了。
examples.en: He signed a contract with the company yesterday.

examples.zh: 我们下周就要签约了。
examples.en: We're signing the contract next week.

examples.zh: 你签约以前，一定要看清楚合同。
examples.en: Before you sign, be sure to read the contract carefully.

note: Used for rules and systems: 法律漏洞, 系统漏洞; also a leak or hole.

examples.zh: 这个系统有一个漏洞。
examples.en: This system has a flaw.

examples.zh: 他的说法有很多漏洞。
examples.en: His account has many holes.

examples.zh: 要尽快补上这个漏洞。
examples.en: We need to fix this gap as soon as possible.

note: Goes before the verb; often 悄悄地: 悄悄地走了.

examples.zh: 孩子睡了，我们悄悄地出去吧。
examples.en: The child is asleep; let's slip out quietly.

examples.zh: 他悄悄地告诉我一个秘密。
examples.en: He quietly told me a secret.

examples.zh: 她悄悄地把钱放在桌子上。
examples.en: She secretly put the money on the table.

note: Business and news register: 国际贸易, 对外贸易.

examples.zh: 中国和越南的贸易越来越多。
examples.en: Trade between China and Vietnam keeps growing.

examples.zh: 他在一家贸易公司工作。
examples.en: He works at a trading company.

examples.zh: 国际贸易对经济很重要。
examples.en: International trade is important for the economy.

note: 便利店 (convenience store); as verb: 为大家提供便利.

examples.zh: 住在地铁站旁边，上班很便利。
examples.en: Living next to a metro station makes getting to work convenient.

examples.zh: 附近有一家便利店。
examples.en: There is a convenience store nearby.

examples.zh: 手机支付给我们带来了很多便利。
examples.en: Mobile payment has made life much more convenient for us.
